observations.description: No network/credential/live imports. trading_authority=False in lock, health, alerts, and all returned objects.
One authoritative state: PaperAdapterCheckpointStoreV1 is sole durable source. No legacy gateway checkpoint used. Restart/reconcile/execute all transact through adapter store.

Halt boundary: halt() verifies integrity, activates kill switch, disconnects, requires reconciliation, preserves records/receipts, deterministic, cannot clear existing kill switch. Store.halt() persists atomically under writer lock.
Ownership: O_CREAT|O_EXCL lock, second owner rejected, malformed/mismatched lock rejects, no cross-release, ownership loss prevents cycle.
Startup: first initializes once, existing triggers restart, corrupt fails closed, startup failure releases lock, __enter__ exception releases lock.
Chronology: UTC required for now and input_observed_at, future halts, stale halts, age at boundary (5s) accepted, zero/negative policy durations reject.
Safety precedence: ownership > timestamp > stop > stale/future > reconciliation > command. Stop before stale/future, stale/future before reconciliation.
Controlled stop: session-bound, stop=True, trading_authority=False required, malformed/foreign/false/extra-field reject, STOPPED state, disconnects, no command in same cycle.
Stale/future halt: durably checkpointed before health, kill switch active, disconnected, reconciliation required, no command in same cycle, repeated halt no conflict.
Reconciliation: cannot execute before, exact observation restores (only without kill switch), mismatch persisted with kill switch, unsolicited rejects, no trading authority, cannot clear kill switch.
Command execution: only after all gates, exact retry idempotent, conflict rejects, duplicate order no exposure, receipt persisted before health.
Health: frozen, deterministic, heartbeat binds all material fields, adapter_id and gateway_snapshot_id match persisted checkpoint, atomic replace, no false HEALTHY after halt/stop.
Alerts: non-HEALTHY or rejected command alerts, no healthy alert, SHA-256 event_id, no sensitive fields, deduplicated, compatible with read_alerts.
Context manager: normal exit releases lock, exceptions release lock, startup exceptions release lock, no silent lock deletion.
Content addressing: identical initial + cycles produce deterministic state, session_id must be 32-char lowercase UUID hex.
Implementation coupling: imports only paper_exchange_adapter_checkpoint_v1 and paper_exchange_adapter_v1 public contracts. No legacy gateway checkpoint.
